column3: NASB follows the critical text; “soon” is rendered “quickly.”
NASB renders “troubled Himself” as “was troubled” and adds “also.”
NASB renders “to have caused that … not have died” as “have kept this man also from dying.”
NASB follows the critical text; “he stinks” is rendered “there will be a stench,” and it adds “been dead.”
NASB follows the critical text without “from the place where the dead man was lying.”
NASB follows the critical text; “linen strips” is rendered “wrappings,” and “headcloth” is “cloth.”
NASB follows the critical text, but names “Jesus.”
NASB renders “gathered a council” as “convened a council.”
NASB renders “You know nothing” as “You know nothing at all.”
NASB follows the critical text (“for you”); “consider” is rendered “take into account.”
NASB follows the critical text; “from himself” is rendered “on his own initiative.”
NASB follows the critical text; “show it” is rendered “report it.”
